name: cluck-life
description: Raise, train, and fight your chicken on a cozy 3D farm. Phone-first browser game.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/vendor && cp index.html game.js world.js app.js dist/ && cp vendor/three.module.min.js dist/vendor/ && node -e "require('./dist/game.js')" && test -s dist/vendor/three.module.min.js && echo built dist/
